title: The Diesel Deal, Reduced
notes: Ted at the desk; the graphmap behind him with the piece hung on it. Each beat is one TTS call; starts come from the audio (timeline.json). map.reveal = tape seconds of the piece shown so far ('all' = whole tape). map.focus = line index to brighten.

beats.text: Breaking Points, October twelfth. Seventeen minutes on the energy ceasefire. Krystal, Saagar, and a few people they quoted. Here's what the segment was actually about.
beats.caption: Breaking Points · Oct 12 · 17:07

beats.text: The scoreboard. The object is the diesel deal. Trump declared it delivered. Plus one, all the way. The show read it as not delivered. Minus point seven. Segment Dia is forty-six. That's the oscillation zone. Lumens: forty-one. Less than half the light got through.
beats.caption: Declared z +1.0 · Read z −0.73 · Dia 46 · Lumens 41

beats.text: Three lines carried it. One. Gregory Brew, on the numbers. Three hundred thousand tons a month is seventy-four thousand barrels a day. The U.S. makes three point six six million. That's a few percent. Dia ten. Clean reading. Touches the object directly.
beats.caption: Brew · RI · Dia 10 · z −0.6 · “a few percent”

beats.text: Two. The sanctions analysts. Hours before the deal, he signed the Graham sanctions act. An OFAC license cannot override a statute. Thirty-day notice. Dia fourteen. That's a method line. It says how you'd check.
beats.caption: Sanctions analysts · RI · Dia 14 · z −0.9 · method

beats.text: Three. Krystal, at the end. He literally invented this ceasefire out of whole cloth. Dia seventy-eight. Inverted lens. Same object, read through what she thinks of the man. Still lands at minus one.
beats.caption: Ball · LP · Dia 78 · z −1.0 · inverted lens

beats.text: The gap. Everybody on the show landed in the same place: not delivered. Minus point seven, minus point nine, minus one. The split isn't left versus right. It's inside the left panel. Krystal's lines run from twenty to eighty-six Dia on the same object. Same conclusion, very different amounts of light.
beats.caption: Split · intra · LP · 0.6

beats.text: Lumens, forty-one. Of the lines that touched the record, a bit less than half got through clean. The rest was about the man. That's not a judgment. It's a reading. The deal said three million tons by the end of the year. We'll know in December.
beats.caption: Lumens 41 · the deal says 3M tons by year end

beats.text: That's the Diesel Deal, reduced. I'm Ted Turner. This has been the Parallelogram Report.
beats.caption: theparallelogram.report
